detail.longDescription: Ang Li, CEO & co‑founder of Simular AI and former Google DeepMind research scientist, joins us. Takeaways: 1) Real‑world computer use is the final frontier to AGI. 2) Shifting data distributions cause models to break in production. 3) AI agents improve by a Power Law of Practice. 4) Balancing capability with reliability is crucial. Listen: https://www. analysepodcast.com/simular-ai- and-computer-use-is-the-final-frontier-in-ai-with-ang-li/ # AI # AGI # MachineLearning
